sources.entry: Mingo - Easy to use MongoDB GUI with mind-blowing features.

summary.name: Mingo
summary.one_liner: Mingo is a MongoDB GUI client for browsing, querying, building aggregations, and comparing or syncing databases.
use_cases: build aggregation pipelines without writing JSON
filter documents by date with shorthand syntax
compare and sync databases or collections
detect schema errors or inconsistent field names
generate MongoDB queries from plain-English prompts
summary.what_it_does: Mingo connects directly to MongoDB databases and shows documents in a tree and grid view, with user-pinned columns. It recognizes document references and lets you preview or open them. Shorthand syntax such as #last7Days filters date fields, and a search shortcut turns plain values into field queries. Its visual aggregation builder lets you assemble pipelines with drag-and-drop stages, and a schema analyzer looks for errors or misspelled fields. It can also compare and sync collections, documents, and indexes across databases, and includes an AI assistant that writes queries from plain-English requests using your own API key.
notable: Date shorthand filters like #last7Days in query fields
AI assistant using own OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or Grok API key
Compare and sync entire databases with one click
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Windows is not named on the page; Linux is mentioned only in a user testimonial
AI assistant requires the user to bring their own API key from a third-party provider
